page_title: KOL 0-2 STU | FC Koln v Stuttgart 30/09/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' That's all for today as the game is over.
90+5' FC Koln couldn't find the way to score from a mid-range free kick as Alexander Nubel (VfB Stuttgart) leaped high and intercepted the cross.
90+4' Hiroki Ito (VfB Stuttgart) has picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue.
90+3' Hiroki Ito (VfB Stuttgart) is having a really tough time right now. We are about to find out how serious his injury is.
90+2' 8:4 – the corner kicks stats.
90' We will have 6 min. of added time.
88' 0 - 2 Goal! Deniz Undav (VfB Stuttgart) was in the right place at the right time to get to the rebound inside the box and gleefully rifles the ball low inside the right post. It's 0:2.
88' Serhou Guirassy (VfB Stuttgart) shows off his amazing technique to get in front of goal by himself. He pulls the trigger but sends the ball onto the left post. Nice run, but unlucky finish!
86' Enzo Millot will be replaced by Lilian Egloff (VfB Stuttgart).
86' It's time for a substitution. That's the last involvement from Pascal Stenzel as he is replaced by Dan-Axel Zagadou (VfB Stuttgart).
86' It's time for a substitution. Maximilian Mittelstadt (VfB Stuttgart) comes on in place of Chris Fuhrich.
86' Here is a change. Linton Maina is going off and Steffen Baumgart gives the last tactical orders to Max Finkgrafe (1. FC Koln).
86' The attendance for today's match is 50000.
85' Alexander Nubel pulls off a great save to deny Faride Alidou (1. FC Koln), who makes himself some space inside the box and unleashes a quick shot towards the middle of the goal.
84' Dejan Ljubicic (1. FC Koln) picks up a pass and hits the ball towards the top of the net, but he can't generate enough power to trouble Alexander Nubel.
83' Leart Paqarada (1. FC Koln) goes over to take the corner kick and it looks like he will swing the ball into the penalty box.
83' Wow, what an escape. Timo Hubers (1. FC Koln) has an effort from inside the box but it's brilliantly blocked. The ball goes out of play. FC Koln are awarded a corner kick.
82' Leart Paqarada (1. FC Koln) sends the corner into the box, but Alexander Nubel intercepts it and averts the threat.
79' Enzo Millot (VfB Stuttgart) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Tobias Stieler had an easy-decision to make.
79' Pascal Stenzel (VfB Stuttgart) strikes from the edge of the box, but hits it really poorly and sends the ball way over the bar.
76' Today's match ends for Denis Huseinbasic who will be replaced by Damion Downs (1. FC Koln).
76' Enzo Millot (VfB Stuttgart) lashes the ball towards goal from outside the penalty area, but it goes narrowly over the crossbar.
76' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Stuttgart comes to nothing.
76' What a goal-scoring opportunity! Silas (VfB Stuttgart) finds some space inside the box and fires a volley at goal, but the shot is amazingly blocked by a defender. Stuttgart earn a corner.

74' Luca Waldschmidt (1. FC Koln) gathers a pass, skips past an opponent and lets fly from mid-range. His effort, however, is well wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Stuttgart.
73' The manager has been forced to make a substitution and the injured Jamie Leweling limps off the pitch to be replaced by Silas (VfB Stuttgart).
73' Luca Waldschmidt (1. FC Koln) gets on the end of a lofted pass near the penalty spot, but it's a poor header and drifts high over the bar.
73' FC Koln work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.
72' Linton Maina (1. FC Koln) tries to send a pass but it's blocked. FC Koln will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
70' Jamie Leweling (VfB Stuttgart) picks up an injury.

68' 0 - 1 GOAL! Superb work from Chris Fuhrich, who plays a vital role in the build-up. He squares it to Deniz Undav (VfB Stuttgart), who beats Marvin Schwabe with a brilliant shot into the bottom left corner. 0:1.

67' Faride Alidou (1. FC Koln) latches on to a precise pass and one-on-one with the keeper slams the ball towards the middle of the goal. Alexander Nubel is alert, though, and makes an easy save to deny him.
64' Luca Waldschmidt (1. FC Koln) tries to find Faride Alidou, but he puts too much power on the pass.
62' Sebastian Hoeness is forced to make an unplanned substitution as Atakan Karazor (VfB Stuttgart) suffers an injury and Deniz Undav comes on.
60' Steffen Baumgart decides to make a substitution. Steffen Tigges will be replaced by Faride Alidou (1. FC Koln).
60' Substitution. Florian Kainz did his best and is replaced by Luca Waldschmidt (1. FC Koln).
60' Atakan Karazor (VfB Stuttgart) is lying on the ground after being tackled and the physio comes onto the pitch to give him medical treatment.
60' Leart Paqarada (1. FC Koln) aims for the middle of the goal, but that's an easy job for the goalkeeper. It will take more than that to test him!
59' Tobias Stieler blows his whistle after Timo Hubers (1. FC Koln) brings one of his opponents down with a strong tackle.
58' Florian Kainz (1. FC Koln) decides to try his luck with a first-time bullet of a shot. Unfortunately for him, he doesn't hit the ball perfectly and his effort ends well wide of the left post.

57' Jamie Leweling (VfB Stuttgart) receives a short pass inside a congested penalty area and takes a first-time shot. The effort heads towards the middle of the goal but Marvin Schwabe blocks the shot with his legs.
55' Denis Huseinbasic (1. FC Koln) receives a yellow card for a nasty tackle.
53' Chris Fuhrich (VfB Stuttgart) breaks past challenges inside the box, but puts too much pace on his pass to Serhou Guirassy.
52' Hiroki Ito plays a lofted ball into Serhou Guirassy (VfB Stuttgart) near the penalty spot, but the ball flies off the top of his head and goes high over the bar.

50' Linton Maina (1. FC Koln) found some space to dink a cross from the side into the box, but it needed to be more precise to threaten the opposition. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Stuttgart.
48' Leart Paqarada (1. FC Koln) sends a cross into the box, but Alexander Nubel comes off his line to gather the ball.
46' Stuttgart are ruled offside.
46' Tobias Stieler blows his whistle and the second half starts.
45+4' The referee blows his whistle for half-time, bringing to a close the first 45 minutes of the match.
45+1' Tobias Stieler blows the whistle, Timo Hubers (1. FC Koln) is penalised for a foul.
45' 3 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
44' Davie Selke (1. FC Koln) finds himself beyond the last defender, but the game is stopped by the referee after the linesman signals for offside.
42' Serhou Guirassy (VfB Stuttgart) connects with a cross from the side, but produces a header which goes miles wide of the left post.
39' The number of shots on goal at present is 1:1.
36' Linton Maina (1. FC Koln) produces a lovely chip pass into the box, but one of the opposition players cuts it out.
34' FC Koln force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
34' Leart Paqarada (1. FC Koln) sends a lofted cross into the penalty area. Unfortunately for him, the opponent's defence deals with his cross comfortably and intercepts it. FC Koln win a corner.
34' Florian Kainz (1. FC Koln) is about to take a corner kick.
33' FC Koln have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.

32' Dejan Ljubicic (1. FC Koln) receives a clever pass and shoots from mid-range. His shot looks like it's going into the roof of the net, but Alexander Nubel has other ideas and makes a brilliant save. FC Koln will take a corner kick.
29' Chris Fuhrich (VfB Stuttgart) floats the ball in from the corner but it's intercepted.
28' The free kick is taken by Angelo Stiller (VfB Stuttgart), but ball is cleared. The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Stuttgart.
26' Dejan Ljubicic (1. FC Koln) shouldn't be surprised it's a yellow from the ref, who cooled the situation down well.
25' FC Koln fail to score from a corner as Alexander Nubel (VfB Stuttgart) leaps to collect the ball.

24' Davie Selke (1. FC Koln) receives a good pass and from just outside the box he unleashes a promising strike, but the shot is blocked by the defender. The ball is out of play. FC Koln will have a chance to score from a corner.

23' Hiroki Ito (VfB Stuttgart) fashions a shot from the edge of the box after receiving an accurate pass. Marvin Schwabe makes a stunning save to stop the effort from flying into the bottom left corner.
22' Stuttgart enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.
18' Angelo Stiller (VfB Stuttgart) was trying to get to the ball but clattered into the legs of the opponent as well. Tobias Stieler blows his whistle for an infringement.
14' Florian Kainz (1. FC Koln) manages to dispossess his opponent of the ball, but he commits a foul in the process and the referee blows his whistle.
11' Stuttgart can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.

11' Atakan Karazor (VfB Stuttgart) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender. Stuttgart have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
10' Chris Fuhrich (VfB Stuttgart) attempts to find one of his teammates inside the box with a chip pass, but one of the defending players reacts superbly and intercepts the ball.
8' The linesman raises his flag as one of the players from FC Koln was in an offside position.
7' A cross arrives in the goalmouth from the resulting corner kick. Serhou Guirassy (VfB Stuttgart) outjumps the defence, but his promising header bounces away off the bar!
7' The ball goes behind for a corner. Stuttgart will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
6' Timo Hubers (1. FC Koln) gets on the ball and beats an opponent, but his run is stopped by the referee Tobias Stieler who sees an offensive foul.
5' The referee awards a corner and Florian Kainz (1. FC Koln) goes over to take it.
4' Linton Maina (1. FC Koln) fails to pick a body out in the box with an over-hit cross to the back post. The ball goes out of play and Stuttgart will have a goal kick.
3' Neat passing move from Stuttgart in order to create new attacking opportunities.
1' Here we go, today's match is starting right now.
FC Koln will kick the game off.
Tobias Stieler got the nomination for today's game and will try his best to be a fair judge and not make any mistakes.
